title: response
description: The engineer's answer to the feedback items raised by the testers: one entry per item, in the order the items were given.

type.description: Omit this. The orchestrator stamps it when it stores the message.

responses.description: One response per feedback item you were given. Answer every item, even the ones you disagree with.

response_item.description: What you did about one feedback item.

item_id.description: The id of the feedback item you are answering, copied exactly.

action.description: fixed means you changed the code; pushback means you disagree and want the tester to reconsider; wontfix means the item is out of scope for this bead.

rationale.description: Why. Required for pushback and wontfix; for fixed, say briefly what you changed.

then.$comment: Disagreeing with a tester requires a stated reason (D-08).
